command.summary: Create a new role assignment for a user, group, or service principal.

parameters.name: --scope
parameters.help: Scope at which the role assignment or definition applies to, e.g., /subscriptions/0b1f6471-1bf0-4dda-aec3-111122223333, /subscriptions/0b1f6471-1bf0-4dda- aec3-111122223333/resourceGroups/myGroup, or /subscriptions/0b1f6471-1bf0-4dda-aec3- 111122223333/resourceGroups/myGroup/providers/Microsoft.Compute/ virtualMachines/myVM.

parameters.name: --assignee
parameters.help: Represent a user, group, or service principal. supported format: object id, user sign-in name, or service principal name.

parameters.name: --assignee-object-id
parameters.help: The assignee's object ID (also known as principal ID). Use this argument instead of '--assignee' to bypass Microsoft Graph query in case the logged-in account has no permission or the machine has no network access to query Microsoft Graph.

parameters.name: --assignee-principal-type
parameters.help: Use with --assignee-object-id to avoid errors caused by propagation latency in Microsoft Graph.

parameters.name: --condition
parameters.help: Condition under which the user can be granted permission. WARNING: Argument '--condition' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --condition-version
parameters.help: Version of the condition syntax. If --condition is specified without --condition-version, default to 2.0. WARNING: Argument '--condition-version' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --description
parameters.help: Description of role assignment. WARNING: Argument '--description' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: A GUID for the role assignment. It must be unique and different for each role assignment. If omitted, a new GUID is generated.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
